page.overview:
Who is Hattori Tatsu?

Hattori Tatsu was the former sensei of and the main antagonist of the episode "The Forgotten Swordsman."

Hattori Tatsu is a masked swordsman who was the right-hand man of the and mostly operated in Japan. While Tatsu was born blind, he had talents that were discovered by Shredder who brought him into the . He was also a trainer of . Sometime after the death of Super-Shredder, Karai made an attempt on Tatsu's life but failed. Since then, Tatsu began to recruit some that left Karai's side when they started to doubt her leadership, and desired to obtain the in order take control of the Foot Clan entirely.

After defeating Karai and in the first battle, Tatsu knocked aside and encountered a revived who offered him to help bring the Foot Clan back together, which made Rahzar question his own loyalty to Shredder. When it came to the fight at one of the Foot Clan's safe-houses, Karai and Shinigami were assisted by the , , and . Even though Karai knocked off his oni mask where his backstory was explored, Tatsu managed to badly defeat Casey Jones and Shinigami. With help from the Turtles using Casey Jones' explosive pucks, Karai was able to throw off Tatsu's senses and defeat him. Rahzar showed up with and . As the Kuro Kabuto was claimed, Kavaxas drained Tatsu of his soul and then destroyed the Foot Clan safe-house. It is heavily implied that he is burned into ashes from off-screen after Kavaxas fires from his fire breathing mouth.

Tatsu's spirit would later appear in End Times after Kavaxas was free of Tiger Claw’s control, but ended up getting sent back into the Netherworld by April, , and .
